scope: Normal macOS arm64 startup and affected renderer checks; broad UI/MCP qualification remains paused.
problem: Native menus shared a render schedule with the CAD scene; macOS synchronous 3D pipeline creation blocked UI frames and Winit progress.

fix.ui: Main Winit app has a UI-only renderer, without PBR/gizmo 3D rendering. Input, controller state, picking, annotations and orientation controls remain authoritative in this app.
fix.cad: The existing CAD renderer runs in a windowless Bevy app on an owned thread using the same GPU device and queue. Its compilation cannot hold the UI render schedule.
fix.state: One bounded request in flight; intervening changes coalesce into the latest state. Delta snapshots share immutable geometry and poses and keep unchanged document/presentation state resident.
fix.textures: Only GPU handles cross the channel. Three leased render textures protect displayed and extracted frames from overwrite. No CPU pixel readback or duplicate model manager.
fix.ownership: Reject other-document and incompatible-size frames. Present the current owner latest completed camera frame while input continues; full render receipts require the exact scene/camera stamp and ready UI pipelines.
fix.idle: The worker sleeps on its request channel and wakes Winit when a completed frame arrives.
fix.native_feature: Enable the pinned wgpu std feature so native error validation scopes have thread-local ownership, as documented. A deterministic regression nests scopes on two threads and pops the UI scope while the worker scope remains active.
